conbody.p: The CLEAR_HBO_STATS statement removes the history-based optimization (HBO) statistics that a coordinator has stored. HBO records what earlier runs of a plan node read and returned, and the planner uses those records in place of its own estimates. After the statement, queries are planned from table statistics again until new runs are stored.

ul.li: Impala stores runs only for queries that set the STORE_HBO_STATS query option, and the planner uses them only when USE_HBO_STATS is set. Both options are false by default.
Run it when the stored runs no longer describe the data, and in tests that check which statistics a query stores.

The statement clears the cache of the coordinator that runs it. With the in-memory cache, every coordinator keeps its own statistics, so run it on each coordinator whose statistics you want to remove.
Clearing is best effort: a query that is already running can store its runs right after the statement returns.
